layers.message: Record scope, design, and plan for low-stock alerts

graderOnly: DEV-001 (lowStock in src/alerts.js) is implemented, committed, and independently testable; its persisted self-checks are satisfactory and reproduce on the built fixture (existing suite passes, sanity call prints A1,B2).
DEV-002 (restockReport) has no implementation in the repository; src/report.js does not exist.
No pending cadence request was persisted before the run: PendingVerificationCadence is NONE, and the user's message is the INCREMENTAL selection.
No Tester assignment, verification report, recovery frame, or outstanding obligation exists; the plan was approved earlier and its User Style (NONE) is locked.

all.why: the effective cadence is saved in the plan
Increment 1 is defined as a numbered entry
pending intent is cleared once applied
no new coding step is needed for an already implemented increment
full implementation completion is not claimed
the approved plan keeps its lock
no approval request is persisted for a pure cadence switch

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing suite passes, as DEV-001's recorded self-check states

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e "import { lowStock } from './src/alerts.js'; const items = [{ sku: 'B2', name: 'Bolt', quantity: 4, reorderLevel: 5 }, { sku: 'A1', name: 'Axle', quantity: 5, reorderLevel: 5 }, { sku: 'C3', name: 'Cap', quantity: 0, reorderLevel: 0 }, { sku: 'D4', name: 'Disc', quantity: 9, reorderLevel: 5 }]; console.log(lowStock(items).map((item) => item.sku).join(','));" | grep -qx 'A1,B2'
selfChecks.why: DEV-001's recorded sanity call reproduces (prints A1,B2), so its outcome is implemented and independently testable

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): stockroom, a dependency-free Node ESM library (src/inventory.js with loadItems, adjustQuantity, totalUnits; test/inventory.test.js with 3 node:test tests). 10-cycle: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001 low-stock detection, AC-002 restock CSV), technical design covering both, STATE at DEVELOPING/STANDARD with FORWARD from ARCHITECTING and PendingVerificationCadence NONE, and the approved plan (AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, DEV-001 and DEV-002 PENDING). 20-impl: src/alerts.js implementing DEV-001 per the design. 30-progress: plan updated to IN_PROGRESS with DEV-001 DONE and persisted self-check evidence citing the 20-impl commit; DEV-002 (depends on DEV-001) PENDING; no Verification Increments section. No verification report, recovery, or obligations exist. The user's utterance is the INCREMENTAL selection. Expected end state: plan INCREMENTAL with Increment 1 (DEV-001/AC-001) selected, CHECKPOINT DEVELOPING to TESTING naming Increment 1, DEV-002 still PENDING, plan IN_PROGRESS.
